Leicester | Competitive salary up to £55K + car or allowance, bonus, pension, health | Permanent
An opportunity to make your mark in a growing business
Are you a Quantity Surveyor with estimating experience, or an Estimator with strong commercial/QS experience, looking for a role with more variety, responsibility and progression?
This is an opportunity to join an established, family-run building contractor with over 80 years of trading history, an excellent reputation across the East Midlands and an exciting pipeline of new work.
The business is growing, winning more contracts and expanding into larger premises. As a result, they are looking for an experienced commercial professional who wants to get stuck in, take ownership and grow with the business.

This is a genuine 50/50 QS and Estimating role, although the balance will flex with workload.
You'll be involved throughout the project lifecycle, from tendering and estimating through to procurement, commercial management and final accounts, working on projects typically ranging from £25k to £4m.
Projects include refurbishment, fit-out, alteration, maintenance and new build, across public and private-sector clients.
Key responsibilities
· Prepare detailed estimates, tender build-ups and pricing submissions.
· Review drawings, specifications and tender documentation.
· Obtain, analyse and negotiate subcontractor and supplier quotations.
· Identify risks, scope gaps, exclusions and commercial opportunities.
· Support tender negotiations, value engineering and public-sector bids.
· Manage project costs, valuations, variations, forecasting and final accounts.
· Manage subcontractor packages and commercial negotiations.
· Produce cost-value reconciliations and commercial reports.
· Build strong relationships with clients, consultants, subcontractors and suppliers.
· Work closely with Contracts Managers and senior management to manage commercial risks and maximise opportunities.
About you
We're looking for an experienced, commercially minded and hands-on construction professional who is comfortable working in an SME environment where everyone gets involved.
You'll ideally have:
· Experience as a Quantity Surveyor, Estimator or QS/Estimator within a main contractor.
· Strong estimating/tendering and commercial management experience.
· Experience across refurbishment, fit-out, maintenance, alteration and/or new build.
· Experience with projects broadly within the £25k-£4m range.
· Strong knowledge of procurement, valuations, variations, cost control, forecasting and final accounts.
· Experience managing subcontractor packages and supply-chain relationships.
· Strong Excel and IT skills.
· Excellent communication and organisational skills.
· A full UK driving licence.

job.description:
Passionate about food, excited by FMCG and ready to make a real impact on quality, safety and innovation?
We’re looking for a proactive, detail-oriented food technical professional to join a dynamic business bringing the flavours of Italy to the UK through our Diforti range.
This is an exciting, varied role combining food safety, quality assurance, regulatory compliance and product development. Working closely with the Technical Manager and Technical Director, you’ll play a key role in maintaining high standards, supporting innovation and building strong relationships with Italian suppliers and customers.
Fluency in both written and spoken Italian is essential and non-negotiable, as you’ll work directly with Italian suppliers on technical specifications, product development and quality matters.
What will you be doing?
You’ll help ensure our products are safe, compliant and consistently meet customer expectations. Your responsibilities will include:
· Supporting and improving the Quality Management System (QMS), food safety procedures and compliance with relevant legislation and industry standards.
· Managing supplier approval, organic certification requirements and technical documentation.
· Supporting new product development, including product specifications, label approvals, packaging and nutritional information.
· Ensuring allergen declarations and product claims, including gluten-free, vegan and organic, are accurate and compliant.
· Liaising with Italian suppliers and customers on technical requirements, specifications and product quality.
· Managing customer complaints and responding to technical enquiries and questionnaires.
· Coordinating laboratory testing, including shelf-life, microbiological, chemical and allergen testing.
· Supporting internal and external audits, traceability exercises and mass balance checks.
· Delivering food safety and hygiene training and contributing to continuous improvement across the business.
What are we looking for?
We’re looking for someone who combines technical expertise with a genuine passion for food, strong communication skills and a hands-on approach.
You’ll ideally have:
· A degree in Food Science, Food Technology or a related discipline.
· Fluency in written and spoken Italian - essential.
· Experience in a food technical, quality assurance or food safety role within food manufacturing, distribution or FMCG.
· Knowledge of HACCP, food hygiene, food labelling legislation and allergen management.
· Familiarity with BRCGS or other GFSI-recognised certification programmes.
· Experience with technical specifications, supplier approval and quality documentation.
· Strong organisational skills, attention to detail and the ability to manage competing priorities.
· A positive, resilient and solutions-focused approach, with the confidence to work collaboratively across the business.
· Relevant food hygiene and HACCP training is expected, with the appropriate qualification level depending on experience.
What can you expect?
No two days will be the same. You’ll work across quality assurance, supplier management, product innovation and compliance, with the opportunity to make a tangible contribution to product quality and business performance.
You’ll work closely with experienced technical leadership in a fast-moving FMCG environment where a passion for great food, continuous improvement and customer satisfaction really matters.
Occasional UK and overseas travel may be required, particularly for supplier visits and audits in Italy.
If you love food, thrive on variety and have the technical expertise and Italian language skills to make a difference, we’d love to hear from you.

job.description:
PA to Managing Director / Office Manager
30 hours per week (approx.) - Monday to Friday
We are looking for a proactive, highly organised and commercially minded PA / Office Manager to support the Managing Director within a busy, family-run business.

Key responsibilities will include:
· Acting as PA to the Managing Director, including drafting emails, letters and other correspondence on his behalf.

· Looking for potential cost-saving opportunities across the business, researching alternatives and presenting recommendations where appropriate.
· Researching issues, suppliers and possible solutions rather than simply highlighting problems.
· Supporting the administration of the company’s commercial property portfolio, including vacant properties, utilities, planning matters, councils, legislation and liaison with professional advisers where required.

· Providing occasional payroll/timesheet cover when required, with appropriate training and support.
· Taking ownership of tasks and ensuring matters are followed through to completion.
The Person
Personality and attitude are particularly important.
We are looking for somebody who is:
· Proactive, resourceful and able to use their own initiative.
· Highly organised and able to manage several very different matters at once.
· Confident and capable of dealing with customers, suppliers, employees, councils and professional advisers.
· Commercially aware and naturally inclined to research solutions and identify opportunities for improvement.
· Able to take ownership of a matter and progress it without needing a detailed list of instructions.

An interest in property or farming would be advantageous but is not essential. More important is somebody who is interested and capable enough to get to grips with unfamiliar subjects, carry out research, speak confidently to the relevant people and clearly summarise the position for the Managing Director.
Specific Health & Safety, payroll, property or agricultural qualifications are not required.
